info.name: TransferZero Account Debits Payout Methods API

params.name: state
params.description:
Allows filtering results by `state` of the payout method.

Example: `/v1/payout_methods?state[]=enabled`

params.name: type
params.description:
Allows filtering results by the specified type.

Example: `/v1/payout_methods?type[]=NGN::Bank`

params.name: sender_id
params.description:
Allows filtering results by the specified sender id.

Example: `/v1/payout_methods?sender_id=bf9ff782-e182-45ac-abea-5bce83ad6670`

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to request (defaults to 1)

params.name: per
params.description: The number of results to load per page (defaults to 10)

params.name: created_at_from
params.description:
Start date to filter recipients by created_at range
Allows filtering results by the specified `created_at` timeframe.

Example: `/v1/recipients?created_at_from=2018-06-06&created_at_to=2018-06-08`

params.name: created_at_to
params.description:
End date to filter recipients by created_at range
Allows filtering results by the specified `created_at` timeframe.

Example: `/v1/recipients?created_at_from=2018-06-06&created_at_to=2018-06-08`
